Inactive (below 0.25 x max on every token): calendar month names and their abbreviations (January-December all <= 0.64), numerals and years, singular ' second' (0.33), temporal function words and adverbs (then, now, when, before, after, since, until, during, while, already, still, currently, later 0.57, recently 0.52), and ordinary non-time text.
